meta.note: Nothing on this list is implemented. Pick an option for each item; choices are stored only in this browser (localStorage) and are not sent anywhere. The owner decides which changes go ahead.

suggestions.title: Rank by dollar value, not contract count
suggestions.detail: The API reports contracts (flag F-16). Options: keep contracts (verified); add a labelled dollar estimate from trades (needs trades endpoint reading); or defer.
suggestions.risk: Any dollar figure is an estimate unless Kalshi publishes one
options: Add labelled dollar estimate from trades

suggestions.title: Sub-minute price feed
suggestions.detail: REST candlesticks stop at 1 minute (Q-08). Options: keep REST polling every 15 s; add a WebSocket feed for seconds-level ticks; or hours/days only.
suggestions.risk: Connection limits and rate limits (rate_limits doc, not read)

suggestions.title: Liquidity warnings
suggestions.detail: Flag markets with zero volume, a spread wider than a set amount, or no bids (see F-14, F-15). Options: warning badge; hide illiquid markets; both.
suggestions.risk: The threshold is a judgment call

suggestions.title: Trade execution with risk caps
suggestions.detail: Place demo orders only after a key is provided (Q-01), with per-order and per-day caps and a confirmation step. Options: manual confirm each order; auto within caps; defer until strategy is set.
suggestions.impact: Enables the trade and performance sections
suggestions.risk: Orders in the demo still use mock money but need correct signing and limits

suggestions.title: Stale-quote detection
suggestions.detail: Mark markets whose last update is more than a set number of days old (e.g. the Ryder Cup markets, F-13).

suggestions.title: Automatic settlement-source check
suggestions.detail: Flag settlement sources whose publisher name and URL do not match, or that are search links (F-05, F-06, F-11). Options: report only; block those markets from the dashboard; both.
suggestions.risk: Some links may be legitimate aliases

suggestions.title: Full category pagination
suggestions.detail: The snapshot covers only the first chunk of golf, crypto and elections lists (F-21). Options: page everything on a schedule; page on demand in the dashboard; keep the partial list.

suggestions.title: Pre-trade decision checklist
suggestions.detail: Before any trade, show: settlement source (official?), liquidity, last update, fee type, and the question list item it depends on.

suggestions.title: Use production public data as a benchmark
suggestions.detail: Demo prices may differ from real markets (F-17, Q-06). Options: read public production data for the same tickers as a read-only benchmark; stay demo-only.
suggestions.impact: Tests whether demo prices are a useful guide
suggestions.risk: Mixing environments can mislead; label clearly

suggestions.title: Scheduled snapshot refresh
suggestions.detail: Refresh the verified snapshot on a schedule (GitHub Actions cron) and re-run the link and source check. Options: daily; weekly; manual only.
suggestions.risk: Automated commits to main; needs approval

suggestions.title: Keep scheduled server-side snapshots committed to data/
suggestions.detail: collector/ + collect.yml snapshot the demo exchange every 10 minutes (ranked events, orderbooks, candles, resolutions). Keeps decision-grade history and resolutions independent of visitors' browsers.
suggestions.impact: History and yes/no resolution records survive browser/API outages
suggestions.risk: Repo growth from scheduled commits (see SG-3B-08)

suggestions.title: Collector cadence decision
suggestions.detail: 10-minute cadence works (133 requests, 0 errors) but 429s were observed at higher request rates during MVE floods.

suggestions.title: Add demo-account API secrets to activate portfolio/trade analytics
suggestions.detail: Two secrets (KALSHI_DEMO_API_KEY_ID, KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY) turn the implemented pipeline into live tracked demo performance with categorized strategies; without them the site shows truthful awaiting-credentials states.
suggestions.impact: Portfolio performance tracking + trade categorization per the brief
suggestions.risk: Demo credentials only work against demo endpoints; never production

suggestions.title: Seconds-level chart granularity via demo WebSocket
suggestions.detail: REST candles bottom out at 1 minute. A browser WS test against wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co would verify whether market-data channels accept credential-free connections; if yes, add live tick charting.
suggestions.risk: Unverified handshake; may require auth headers browsers cannot send

suggestions.title: Settlement-timer countdowns and close-early flags on event tables
suggestions.detail: Markets expose close_time / can_close_early; showing countdowns avoids trading into imminent settlement.

suggestions.title: Keep estimated dollar volume explicitly labeled everywhere
suggestions.detail: The API reports contracts and prices, not dollar volume; ranking uses sum(volume x last price) and every occurrence is labeled 'estimated'. Never rank silently on it.
suggestions.impact: Prevents misreading an approximation as exchange-reported

suggestions.title: Cross-link category pages to the data-tracking market detail
suggestions.detail: One-click drill-down from category view to chart + orderbook ladder + liquidity.

suggestions.title: Archive data/ snapshots monthly via git tags
suggestions.detail: Bounds repo growth from scheduled commits while keeping history reachable.
